wargear.name: Cold-blooded Princeps
wargear.summary: A Princeps who has spent decades listening to the reactor's heartbeat and never once let it rattle him.
wargear.text: Once per battle, the Controlling Player of a Titan whose Princeps is Cold-blooded may treat one failed Power Hungry or Overload test made by that Titan as having been passed.

wargear.name: Fire-eater Princeps
wargear.summary: A Princeps who fights at the edge of the neural link and lets the engine run hot.
wargear.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Controlling Player's Shooting Phase, a Titan whose Princeps is a Fire-eater may choose one of its Weapons. That Weapon makes its Shooting Attack twice in that Shooting Phase, after which the Titan must make a Power Hungry test with a -1 modifier.

wargear.name: Overlapping void arrays
wargear.summary: Secondary projectors are stitched into the primary lattice, so a collapsing shield is quickly replaced.
wargear.text: The first time in each battle that the Void Shields of a Titan equipped with overlapping void arrays would be reduced to zero, the Controlling Player immediately restores one Void Shield.

wargear.name: Servitor-hardened plates
wargear.summary: Hull plates seeded with banked servitor labour that can be called on to slap armour back over a breach.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Servitor-hardened plates adds 1 to its Hull Points Characteristic.

wargear.name: Legio Battle-banner
wargear.summary: A tattered battle-banner carried on a gantry above the Titan's head, its thread-count of victories read out before every deployment.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Legio Battle-banner has the Banner of Victories Special Rule.

wargear.name: Ghost-void projector
wargear.summary: A masking emitter that smears the Titan's void signature into the dust of the battlefield.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Ghost-void projector has the Void Veil Special Rule.

wargear.name: Reactor sink baffles
wargear.summary: Extra heat baffles bolted around the plasma reactor so it can run harder without cooking the Princeps.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Reactor sink baffles has the Baffled Exhausts Special Rule.

wargear.name: Hardened command throne
wargear.summary: A rebuilt Princeps throne with gyro-cushioning and a stronger neural cage.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Hardened command throne has the Unbroken Throne Special Rule.

wargear.name: Ram-plough
wargear.summary: A wedge of reinforced plating that lets a Triaros smash through barricades and tank traps.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Ram-plough has the Ram-Plough Special Rule.

wargear.name: Pennant of the Void Sentries
wargear.summary: A scorched pennant of the void-gate watch, sworn to stand till relieved.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Pennant of the Void Sentries has the Gate-Watch Oath Special Rule.

wargear.name: Servitor compliance governor
wargear.summary: A strict governor on the maniple's cortex that stops it from over-reaching.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Servitor compliance governor has the Strict Compliance Special Rule.

The Conveyor may be armoured further

The maniple may be fitted with a governor
The Axiarch may exchange his arc lance for

modifiers.text: Pennant of the Void Sentries: Gate-Watch Oath.

rules.name: Pack Hunters
rules.summary: The Warhounds are in the enemy's rear before the enemy knows the hunt has begun.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Outflank Special Rule. In a Battle Turn in which a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule arrives from Reserves, that Unit may Rush and still make a Shooting Attack with one of its Weapons, using its full Ballistic Skill.

rules.name: Overcharged Reactor
rules.summary: The Princeps does not ask the reactor's permission; he tells it how long it has.
rules.text: Once per battle, in the Movement Phase, a Model with this Special Rule may add 6" to its Movement Characteristic until the end of that phase, and may still make Shooting Attacks with all of its Weapons in the following Shooting Phase. That Model then loses 1 Hull Point, and no Saving Throw or Damage Mitigation Test of any kind may be made against that loss.

rules.name: Void-Wall Guard
rules.summary: The armsmen stand beneath the Titan's knees and take the charge that was meant for it.
rules.text: When an enemy Unit declares a Charge against a friendly Titan, and a Unit with this Special Rule is within 6" of that Titan and within the charging Unit's Charge reach, the charging Unit's Controlling Player must instead declare the Charge against the nearest such Unit.

rules.name: Bonded Directive
rules.summary: The Princeps leads from the Titan's head, and the maniple obeys.
rules.text: While a Unit with this Special Rule is within 12" of a friendly Titan, it cannot gain the Suppressed Tactical Status.

rules.name: Banner of Victories
rules.summary: Every victory is stitched into the banner, and every brother who sees it stands a little taller.
rules.text: Friendly Titans and Secutarii Units within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule add 1 to their Cool Characteristic when they take a Morale Check. A Model with this Special Rule cannot benefit from the Void Veil Special Rule, or from any other modifier that reduces the Hit Tests of Shooting Attacks made against it.

rules.name: Void Veil
rules.summary: A masking emitter smears the Titan into the dust of the battlefield.
rules.text: Shooting Attacks made against a Model with this Special Rule from more than 24" away subtract 1 from their Hit Tests.

rules.name: Baffled Exhausts
rules.summary: Heat baffles let the reactor burn harder, at the cost of the Titan's stride.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to the result of any Power Hungry or Overload test it makes. A Model with this Special Rule cannot Rush.

rules.name: Unbroken Throne
rules.summary: A caged throne rides out the neural backlash.
rules.text: The first time in each battle that a Model with this Special Rule would gain the Stunned or Suppressed Tactical Status, it does not gain that Tactical Status.

rules.name: Ram-Plough
rules.summary: The wedge clears barricades and tank traps, and whatever is caught behind them.
rules.text: A Vehicle with this Special Rule ignores Dangerous Terrain Tests. When it uses its Shock Ram Special Rule, the number of Hits it inflicts is D6+4 instead of D6+3. It subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic.

rules.name: Gate-Watch Oath
rules.summary: The watch stands until it is relieved.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule ignores the first Pinned Tactical Status it would gain in each Battle Turn.

rules.name: Strict Compliance
rules.summary: The governor holds the maniple to its orders and to nothing beyond them.
rules.text: Once per battle, a Unit with this Special Rule may ignore a Stunned or Suppressed Tactical Status it would gain. A Unit with this Special Rule cannot Rush.

armyRules.name: Legio Pack-Bond
armyRules.flavor: Titans of a Legio fight as a pack and wither alone.
benefits: A Titan with another friendly Titan within 12" cannot gain the Pinned or Suppressed Tactical Status.
drawbacks: A Titan with no friendly Titan within 24" cannot Rush and cannot use the Overcharged Reactor Special Rule.
armyRules.condition: when no other friendly Titan is within 24"

armyRules.name: Cortex Tether
armyRules.flavor: The Legio's maniples are slaved to a god-engine's cortex.
benefits: While within 12" of a friendly Titan, an Automata Unit adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic.
drawbacks: While no friendly Titan remains on the battlefield, an Automata Unit subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic and cannot Rush.
armyRules.condition: while within 12" of a friendly Titan

armyRules.name: Armsman's Shieldwall
armyRules.flavor: Void-drilled armsmen hold a line, but they cannot run.
benefits: Secutarii cannot gain the Pinned Tactical Status.

rites.name: The Hunting Pack
rites.flavor: Where the great engines march, the Warhounds have already seen the enemy's backs.
benefits: Warhound Titans may fill Fast Attack slots and gain Vanguard (2).
Warhounds gain Pack Hunters: Outflank, and a Warhound that arrives from Reserves may Rush and still make a Shooting Attack with one Weapon that turn.
limitations: At least two Warhounds are required.
No Reaver, Warbringer or Warlord Titans.
At least half of the Warhounds must start the battle in Reserve.

modifiers.text: The Hunting Pack: Vanguard (2), Pack Hunters.

require.note: A pack needs at least two Warhounds.

rites.name: The Reactor Gambit
rites.flavor: The Princeps do not ask permission of the reactor. They tell it how long it has.
benefits: Every Titan gains Fast (1) and Overcharged Reactor: once per battle, in the Movement Phase, it may add 6" to its Movement Characteristic and still make Shooting Attacks with all of its Weapons.
limitations: At least two Titans are required.
No Titan keeps its Repair Crew, and a Titan that uses Overcharged Reactor loses 1 Hull Point.

modifiers.text: The Reactor Gambit: Fast (1), Overcharged Reactor.

require.note: The gambit needs at least two Titans.

rites.name: The Void-Wall Bastion
rites.flavor: A Titan is only as safe as the men who stand beneath its knees.
benefits: Secutarii Cohorts may fill Elites slots, gain a 4+ Invulnerable Save and Line (2).
Secutarii gain Void-Wall Guard: an enemy Unit that declares a Charge against a friendly Titan must instead charge the nearest Unit with this rule within 6" of that Titan, if it is in Charge reach.
limitations: At least two Secutarii Cohorts are required.
No more than one Titan, and no Warbringer or Warlord.

modifiers.text: The Void-Wall Bastion: best 4+ Invulnerable Save, Line (2), Void-Wall Guard.

require.note: Bring at least two Secutarii Cohorts.

rites.name: The Bonded Cybernetica Maniple
rites.flavor: The Princeps leads from the Titan's head. The Castellaxes lead from nowhere at all.
benefits: Castellax Battle, Castellax Destructor and Domitar Battle Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Castellaxes add 1 to their Ballistic Skill Characteristic.
Maniples gain Bonded Directive: while within 12" of a friendly Titan they cannot gain the Suppressed Tactical Status.

modifiers.text: The Bonded Cybernetica Maniple: Line (1), Bonded Directive.

require.note: A Titan must anchor the Maniples.
